Florida divers remove record 36,187 invasive lionfish in statewide challenge Skip to main content Close Download the App Get your news faster with our mobile experience Install News Weather Videos EN ESPAÑOL Money Watch Live Now 82 ° Thu 84 ° Fri 84 ° Search Search User Icon Watch Florida divers rem … ish (439mm) - Source - Coast Watch Alliance (Photo: Mark Miller) Comment on this story 2 Comment Share story Share topics: Lionfish Florida Invasive species Conservation Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission Divers Marine ecosystems Reef Rangers Florida divers removed 36,187 invasive lionfish from state waters during this year’s Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission Lionfish Challenge, setting a record for the statewide tournament, according to FWC. The challenge drew 533 registered participants, who logged 1,468 dive trips. The total topped last year’s catch of more than 30,000 lionfish, the agency said.
